# Support

Bookmark Scope is a free project kept by one volunteer. This page tells you where to go for each kind of help.

## Read the user guide first

The [user guide](https://enaloo.com/apps/bookmark-scope/) covers installing, the popup, the dashboard, link checks, backup and restore, and settings. Two pages answer most questions:

- [Troubleshooting and FAQ](https://enaloo.com/apps/bookmark-scope/docs/troubleshooting-faq/)
- [Limits and known limitations](https://enaloo.com/apps/bookmark-scope/docs/limits/)

## Ask a question

Open an issue with the [question form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Bookmark-Scope/issues/new?template=question.yml). Say what you want to do and what you tried. Please search [existing issues](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Bookmark-Scope/issues?q=is%3Aissue) first. Someone may have asked already.

## Report a bug

Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Bookmark-Scope/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Include your extension version, browser version and the steps to repeat the problem. Use made-up bookmarks in examples. Do not paste your real bookmark export or private URLs. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs-well) explains what makes a good report.

## Request a feature

Use the [feature request form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Bookmark-Scope/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml). Describe the problem first. This project stays local and asks for few permissions, so some ideas will not fit.

## Fix a translation

Use the [translation fix form](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Bookmark-Scope/issues/new?template=translation_fix.yml), or send a pull request. See [Translations](CONTRIBUTING.md#translations).

## Report a security problem

Do not open a public issue. Use GitHub's [private vulnerability report](https://github.com/ehsanenaloo/Bookmark-Scope/security/advisories/new) and read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Privacy questions

Read the [privacy policy](https://enaloo.com/apps/bookmark-scope/docs/privacy-policy/) (source: [PRIVACY.md](../docs/PRIVACY.md)). For a question it does not answer, open an issue. Do not include personal data.

## What to expect

- Help is given by a volunteer in spare time. Replies are best effort, and there is no guaranteed response time.
- There is no phone, email or chat support.
- Only the latest release is supported. Please update before you report a bug.
- Please be kind. The [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) applies in every issue and pull request.

If you want to help others, answering a question in an issue is a good way to contribute. Developers can run the unit tests with `node scripts/test.mjs`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#checks).
